puzzle.title: The Professor's Safe
puzzle.question: A plaque above the safe reads "Est. MCMXC". Enter the four-digit year to open it.
puzzle.hint: Convert the Roman numerals: M=1000, CM=900, XC=90.

puzzle.title: Rebuild the Night
puzzle.question: Put Thursday night in order, earliest first.
puzzle.event: Verma writes his final logbook entry
Building is locked for the night
puzzle.hint: The keycard swipe happens after the lock-up.
puzzle.success: The footage lines up with that timeline.

puzzle.title: The Locked Account
puzzle.question: The login hint reads: "I have keys but open no doors. I have space but no room." What am I?
puzzle.success: The account opens to its sent folder.

puzzle.title: The Gardener's Riddle
puzzle.question: A note on the garden door: "The more you take, the more you leave behind." What is it?
puzzle.success: Wet prints lead from the garden door.

puzzle.title: Match the Evidence
puzzle.question: Match each item found in the house to its owner.
puzzle.hint: Who was outdoors, who was at dinner, and who cleans?
puzzle.success: The boots match the garden-door prints.

puzzle.title: The Study Safe
puzzle.question: The safe code is the time the clock stopped. Which code opens it?
puzzle.hint: The clock stopped at 11:47. Which options are written as 24-hour times?
